reply_hint: To reply, just write here in DMs.
how_to: Write in this thread — the bot forwards it to the member by DM. Messages starting with `//` are internal notes (not sent).
which_guild: 📨 Modmail is available on several servers. Which staff are you writing to?

opened: 📨 Your message reached the **{guild}** staff. They'll reply here; anything else you write goes to them too.

closed_dm: 🔒 The **{guild}** staff closed the conversation. Writing again opens a new thread.
